purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19004 (FBS-224) driving rcf guidance, rcf build bundle --next --format md and rcf doctor through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-224 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the shipped stage contract text.
title: Guidance, managed agent-instructions block, bundle runbook and README state the five-stage hand contract, Finalise by --ci-run from a Test-stage report, audit as the fifth verb, and doctor flags the old block

testCases.description: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 and its Test stage names the verifier hand, rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier and rcf/verify-reports/, its Finalise stage names rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no "--url <deploy-url>" and no "post-merge verify run"
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/stage-contract.test.js::AC-19004-1: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 and its Test stage names the verifier hand, rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier and rcf/verify-reports/, its Finalise stage names rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no "--url <deploy-url>" and no "post-merge verify run"

testCases.description: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 with the Define stage naming the test-author hand and TS/TC bindings, the Build stage naming the builder for production code, Code Nodes and code-hygiene unit tests only, and every stage naming its Hand: trailer
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/stage-contract.test.js::AC-19004-2: rcf guidance build-cycle exits 0 with the Define stage naming the test-author hand and TS/TC bindings, the Build stage naming the builder for production code, Code Nodes and code-hygiene unit tests only, and every stage naming its Hand: trailer

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next --format md closes with a runbook listing the five stages and hands, rcf verify run --hand verifier, rcf audit separation and rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no finalise --mode or --url
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/stage-contract.test.js::AC-19004-3: rcf build bundle --next --format md closes with a runbook listing the five stages and hands, rcf verify run --hand verifier, rcf audit separation and rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>, with no finalise --mode or --url

testCases.description: rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block states verified is written only by rcf build finalise from a Test-stage report, the release notes carry a non-null minAgentAction, and rcf doctor reports the old block as drifted

testCases.description: rcf doctor on a project whose CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md carries the pre-change managed block reports it drifted, names rcf doctor --fix and exits non-zero
